name: Zingara
description: With Argos, the Paratethyan Sea Leagues: rival coastal thalassocracies of iron-braced outriggers and privateers holding the sea gates and locks between the Paratethys and the open Tethys.
notes: A distant power of the Age of Machinery, beyond the edge of the pre-Shattering chart: known in Narmada from trade, telegraph and war, and deliberately given no position.
